reason: The replacement support needs a broad footing, so preparing the ground seems like a sensible first step.
expectation: I expect the excavator to level or prepare the lander support ground; the footing will probably need additional work.

alternatives.reason: The steel and blocks may form the support, but preparing the ground first seems more practical.

effect: The ground is prepared without disturbing the loaded cribbing, so I can proceed with the footing components.
reaction: Clearing around the loaded supports feels physically sensible.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and the steel and blocks seem useful for the replacement footing.
expectation: I expect a footing or support assembly, though it may need to be installed on the prepared ground afterward.

effect: The footing and braced frame are assembled, ready to be placed on the prepared ground.
reaction: The load-spreading plates and blocks make the construction feel practical.
reason: This is the only offered combination and should install the footing on firm ground.
expectation: I expect the footing to be positioned on the prepared ground, with further work needed to support the lander.

effect: The replacement leg is assembled on firm ground and ready to attach to the lander.
reaction: The progression from prepared ground to a braced support is clear, though predictable.
reason: This is the only offered combination and should connect the new support to the tilted lander.
expectation: I expect the leg to be pinned to the sound joints and help level the platform, though further work may be needed.

effect: The replacement support now carries the lander's weight and the platform is level; the leg will remain behind when the upper cabin lifts away.
reaction: The straight ladder is a satisfying visual payoff, and the service-equipment explanation makes the weight transfer feel plausible.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the replacement leg was the strongest moment: it resolved the damage from the landing with a concrete visual payoff.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the footing was clear but predictable, especially as it was the only offered combination.

surprise.text: The leg stays on Mars when the upper cabin lifts away; that clarified the support's role.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The sequence from firm ground to a load-spreading footing and pinned support had a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would continue to see the return and what Earth makes of the preserved specimens, though this chapter's mostly forced steps were more satisfying as progress than as decisions.
